blocks.text: BANGA, SOUTH COTABATO — The 14-year-old student killed in the Sept. 18 shooting at Banga National High School was laid to rest Saturday as family, classmates, teachers, friends and church members gathered to bid her farewell and call for justice. “Dianne,” not her real name, was buried at Banga Holy Trinity Memorial Park more than two weeks after the shooting that left three students dead, including the alleged 16-year-old gunman, and six others wounded. During a necrological service on Friday, Dianne’s family and members of the Youth of the Iglesia Filipina Independiente, where she was an active member, called on authorities […]...
